title: Room 909
description: Guests who enter Room 909 always check out. But never alive.

seasons.title: The Check-in
seasons.description: A stay you will never forget.

parts.text: The keycard felt heavy in his hand. Room 909. The one everyone warned him about.
The hallway was silent, except for the sound of his own breathing. Or was it someone else's?
When he opened the door, the smell of old perfume and rot hit him like a physical blow.
